# Tabs under the panes (`tab-bar = bottom`; tests/run.sh gives this run a
# config of its own): the strip the top has, under the panes and as wide as
# they are. The panes' grids fill their cards above it (no row hides under
# it), a minimized floating pane's capsule sits above it in a bottom corner,
# and Settings moves it live: to the top, to the left side, back down.
expect-strip-at:bottom
type:echo BOTTOM-$((40+2))
key:enter
wait:0.6
expect:BOTTOM-42
# Renamed in place in its tab, down there: Return keeps it.
key:cmd+shift+r
wait:0.4
type:first
key:enter
wait:0.5
expect-strip:first
tab:new
wait:0.5
key:cmd+shift+r
wait:0.4
type:second
key:enter
wait:0.5
expect-strip:first
expect-strip:second
action:new_split:right
wait:1.0
expect-panes:2
expect-strip-at:bottom
shot:tab-bar-bottom.png
# Minimized, a floating pane's capsule is in the split's corner: over the
# panes, clear of the strip.
action:new_floating_pane
wait:1.2
action:toggle_floating_panes
wait:0.5
expect-capsules:bottom-right:
expect-capsules:clear
expect-strip-at:bottom
capsule:drag:bottom-left
wait:0.5
expect-capsules:bottom-left:
expect-strip-at:bottom
shot:tab-bar-bottom-capsules.png
# Live, from Settings ▸ Interface ▸ Tab style: Above…
key:cmd+,
wait:0.8
settings:press:Above
wait:0.5
expect-strip-at:top
expect-strip:second
shot:tab-bar-bottom-to-top.png
# …Left Side: no strip, the tabs in the sidebar…
settings:press:Left Side
wait:0.5
expect-strip-at:none
expect-tab:first
expect-tab:second
expect-sidebar-shown:yes
# …and Below again, the sidebar folded away with the tabs gone from it.
settings:mark
settings:press:Below
wait:0.5
expect-settings:Below=1
expect-config-change:tab-bar = bottom
settings:close
wait:0.4
expect-strip-at:bottom
expect-sidebar-shown:no
expect-strip:first
expect-capsules:bottom-left:
# A tab's menu down here: tab 1's pane joins this tab, and its tab goes.
tab-menu-not:2:Merge into Current Tab
tab-menu:1:Merge into Current Tab
expect-tab-count:1
expect-panes:3
expect-strip-at:bottom
# Wide, narrow, and dark.
size:1280x720
wait:0.5
expect-strip-at:bottom
shot:tab-bar-bottom-1280.png
size:640x480
wait:0.5
expect-strip-at:bottom
shot:tab-bar-bottom-640.png
appearance:dark
wait:0.4
expect-strip-at:bottom
shot:tab-bar-bottom-640-dark.png
